name: Indian Summer
overview: Lyuba left her husband, went to a young graduate student. To distract her mother from her bitter thoughts, her daughter Masha offered to go on vacation to warm countries. Suddenly, Lyuba’s mother calls — she broke her leg. Warm countries have to be postponed. Lyuba and Masha urgently go to the village to take care of the patient. Lyuba does not suspect that in the remote village where she spent her childhood, she will meet her new love.
